column1: # The games' graphics library as the renderer meets it (docs/RECOMPILATION_PLAN.md §11.1, step 4's step 1): each function's
# Omega Ruby and X addresses (X's from symbols/shared_functions.tsv: identical, or a "call"/"repeated" pair), its name
# (Pomegrade's where it had one, corrected where read otherwise; ours otherwise), its role, what the renderer does with it,
# and how the role is known: traced (the GPU trace, HOS_GPU_TRACE), read (its code, Ghidra), or inferred.
# action: replace (our C in its place calls the renderer), input (its records are read by the renderer, the function kept),
# helper (kept: the replaced ones call it, or nothing needs it once they are replaced), to read (not yet understood).

the batched constants and draw commands of Gfx_BuildCommandList

the BCH's shader program block (+0x38, size +0x3C) when the program changes, then the shader's own block (+0x7C, size +0x80); collects the boolean uniforms into the state (+0x14, +0x2C for the geometry shader)

a fixed 0x170-byte block of default state (after a geometry shader, or when owed)
